name: LeetSwap WETH/HAIR pair fee-transfer drain

classification.summary: LeetSwapV2Pair exposed its fee-transfer helper publicly without caller, token, or amount authorization. An unprivileged caller could move a pair's counterpart-token balance into its fees contract, synchronize the depleted reserve, and drain WETH through the resulting reserve distortion.

loss.notes: The pair sent 110.435942058232220750 WETH to the attack helper. Excluding the helper's identifiable 0.001 WETH setup-swap input leaves exact pre-recovery victim depletion of 110.434942058232220750 WETH, valued at DefiLlama's nearest observation of $1,863.01. The public fee-transfer call also moved the counterpart token into the pair's fees contract; that internal transfer is excluded because claim allocation and recoverability cannot be isolated from the receipts, so no speculative counterpart-token value is assigned.

lastCodeChange.description: LeetSwap factory CREATE2 deployment of this immutable-bearing pair runtime. Archival code is absent in block 2009762 and hashes to 0x5e87699abc7bd271dc8d740e0443e69ef056b6983c6d99b8096439ac5710602f at deployment and immediately before the incident; the pair has no proxy code-selection path.

sources.note: Campaign boundary: calldata enumeration of the original EOA's successful transactions shows 0x075fcdd02922b7c502dff3441ab947e874eee2ab0bf31231770b10508d4258d8 is the sole defect-executing drain transaction against pair 0xba358a0d8b6e920aa5b79836e91737aa3d89354e; other LeetSwap pair deployments are separate records with separate losses and ages. Verified LeetSwapV2Pair source exposes _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens(address,uint256) as a public function with no caller, token, or amount authorization. The transaction trace calls it for the counterpart-token balance, calls sync(), and then swaps the setup tokens for WETH at the corrupted reserves. Code history: factory 0x169c06b4cfb09bfd73a81e6f2bb1eb514d75bb19 CREATE2-deployed the pair in 0x610ff6f0ac41766f05ed3705d870ea56ac0e6c6340e50fdddbc7f0d79a32aa83 at block 2009763:2; archival code is empty in the preceding block and the immutable-bearing direct runtime hashes to 0x5e87699abc7bd271dc8d740e0443e69ef056b6983c6d99b8096439ac5710602f at creation and before the anchor. Loss: receipt Transfer logs show exactly 110.435942058232220750 WETH leaving this pair for helper 0xea8f89f47f3d4293897b4fe8cb69b5c233b9f560. The counterpart-token transfer goes to the pair's own fees contract and is not valued because its claim allocation/recoverability is not isolated.

notes: This pair-specific record is part of a coordinated same-attacker LeetSwap umbrella. Loss is partitioned by pair deployment and is not duplicated across sibling records.
